seed_verification.detail: 60 unique seeds, exactly 0..59, matching frozen protocol

execution_host.cpu: AMD Ryzen 9 9950X (16 physical / 32 logical, single socket)

launch_config.cpu_affinity: none (scheduler spreads 15 single-threaded procs across 16 physical cores)

deviations.description: run_pipeline._mark_done + utils.save_json perform non-atomic, unlocked read-modify-write on a single shared manifest.json. At 15 concurrent shards this loses updates; the live manifest ended with 4 of 61 entries. Latent bug (IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS reports the parallel path verified only at 2 shards, where collisions are rare).
deviations.data_impact: none. Per-unit HPO checkpoints, containment reports, and DP-oracle JSON are each written by a single shard (units never overlap across shards) and were all validated: 45/45 checkpoints at exactly 5 folds with finite regret+CVaR, 15/15 containment reports, DP certified.
deviations.remediation: Reconstructed manifest.json deterministically from the authoritative per-unit artifacts via raw/rebuild_and_validate.py (validates the 61 required entries while assembling). Raw raced manifest preserved as raw/manifest.live_raced.json. No scientific code, hyperparameter, environment, cost-grid, or protocol change.

deviations.description: The runbook's shard-0 finalize step produced distribution_shift_report__{rova,ewma}.json. This is revision-stage and explicitly NOT a completion criterion (runbook section 10). Included as bonus artifacts; reuses already-tuned configs, no new HPO.
